prompt:
Decompose the spec into atomic, testable tickets.

Feature: {{spec-reader.feature_title}}
Core files: {{scaffold-planner.core_files}}
File order: {{scaffold-planner.file_order}}
Risks: {{risk-assessor.risk_matrix}}
Phases: {{risk-assessor.phases}}
Done-when criteria: {{spec-reader.done_when}}

Your task:
1. Create 8-15 granular tickets, each deliverable in 2-4 hours of focused work
2. Each ticket must have:
   - Clear title (e.g., 'T-CONDUCTOR-MEMORY-001: Core schema and migrations')
   - DONE-WHEN: 3-5 specific, testable acceptance criteria
   - Depends-on: which tickets (if any) must complete first
   - Modified files: which files this ticket creates/modifies
   - Estimated tokens: rough estimate of LLM work needed (1k-10k)
3. Order tickets to respect dependencies (can run some in parallel)
4. Group P0/P1 risks into earlier tickets
5. Save architectural/decision tickets (design, config) early
6. Ensure final ticket(s) verify the original DONE-WHEN criteria

Return JSON array:
[
  {
    "id": "T-CONDUCTOR-MEMORY-001",
    "title": "Core schema and migrations",
    "description": "",
    "done_when": [
      "SQLite schema defined in src/schema.ts",
      "10 unit tests pass for schema validation"
    ],
    "depends_on": [],
    "modified_files": ["src/schema.ts", "tests/unit/schema.test.ts"],
    "estimated_tokens": 2000,
    "phase": 1,
    "risk_level": "P0"
  }
]
